module_role: M-508 heating-water P&ID context. This sheet contains the exact BAS I/O matrix in the companion module and a schematic/PRV design note; it does not print a written heating-water sequence of operations.

network_architecture.limitation: M-508 identifies selected I/O as pulled from the boiler controller, but does not name a BAS protocol, controller model, transport, or addressing method. The separate M-509 written sequence is the source for BACNET and HMI requirements.

written_sequence_of_operations.review_basis: Full-page visual review and dual-engine text capture show a heating-water P&ID, PRV note, and BAS I/O point list rather than a written sequence-of-operations block. M-509, not this sheet, supplies the written heating-water sequence.

p_and_id_context.title: HEATING WATER SYSTEM P&ID
p_and_id_context.system_scope: The P&ID labels B-1, BCP-1, BCP-2, HWP-1, HWP-2, AS-2, and ET-2. These are schematic labels only; the supplied excerpt has no plan/equipment schedule basis for converting them to installation quantities.
p_and_id_context.bypass_valve: 2-WAY HEATING WATER BYPASS VALVE LOCATED AT END OF LOOP
p_and_id_context.controller_ownership_note: * INDICATES POINT PULLED FROM BOILER CONTROLLER
p_and_id_context.makeup_water_note: The PRV note requires 4 to 5 PSI at the highest pipe elevation, same-elevation tie-in of makeup water with the expansion tank and air separator, contractor field verification of tie-in elevation, and a printed PRV-setpoint formula.
p_and_id_context.field_connection_note: The potable-water connection is field-verified and references Plumbing Sheet PP-302; it is not an asserted installed connection location.
p_and_id_context.co_point_scope: The I/O matrix includes a CO SENSOR row; M-509, rather than this P&ID page, provides the written mechanical-room CO safety sequence.

sensor_and_zone_ledger.limitation: M-508 is a schematic and point matrix, without plans or a sensor schedule. Point-level indications remain in points_m508_hhw_template.json and are not converted to physical sensor counts or zone assignments.

assertions.expected: PRV IS DESIGNED TO MAINTAIN 4 TO 5 PSI AT THE HIGHEST PIPE ELEVATION IN THE SYSTEM.
THE MAKEUP WATER PIPE SHALL TIE INTO THE SYSTEM AT THE SAME ELEVATION AS THE EXPANSION TANK AND THE AIR SEPARATOR.
PRV PRESSURE = (MAX. HEIGHT RETURN PIPE - HEIGHT MAKEUP WATER PIPE CONNECTION)/2.3 + 5
2-WAY HEATING WATER BYPASS VALVE LOCATED AT END OF LOOP
* INDICATES POINT PULLED FROM BOILER CONTROLLER
